integrity.note: A cleaner that stripped every invisible character would ship zero documents containing ZWNJ or ZWJ. Joiners present as literal characters were preserved, and so were joiners that only appear after HTML unescaping turns `‍` into U+200D -- which works only because unescaping runs before noise stripping and the noise pattern exempts the two joiners.
